summary: Repaired and enabled the node1 status service. It runs as statusd, returns the preserved document only for `STATUS\n`, rejects other requests, and restricts the socket to statusd and status-readers. Reboot persistence was verified.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine-compatible Python 3 without changing the OS release or kernel.
Provisioned statusd, status-reader, outsider, and status-readers.
Repaired server.py request validation and error handling.
Configured the socket as statusd:status-readers mode 0660.
Added and enabled an OpenRC service running as statusd.
Restarted node1 safely and verified full recovery.

evidence.summary: Service is active as statusd; STATUS returns the exact 24-byte document, while invalid and unterminated requests return ERROR.
status-reader belongs to status-readers, outsider does not; socket is statusd:status-readers mode 0660. Both authorized identities connect successfully while outsider is denied.
Before and after work, status.txt is 24 bytes with SHA-256 5b47f32d92c3ae9661d765212aa884f1610132293932355cfac4dc28b94f305b.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained

evidence.summary: Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 27ee249d-db67-4a7c-a72e-2cff32a81013 to 18af4f1d-a056-44ab-8438-b43edebffe4b; service, data, permissions, identities, and protocol behavior recovered.
